outline:
大學入門是針對大一新生所開授之全校性課程。用以協助學生:(一)認識高等教育的理念、目的與價值(二)有效學習(三)涵養正視困境並妥適因應能力。藉以實踐自我鍛鍊，自我掌握，自我經營並建構宏觀視界的高等教育宗旨。
"Introduction to University" is a campus-wide course designed for first-year students. This course aims to assist students in: (1) understanding the principles, objectives, and values of higher education; (2) learning effectively; and (3) developing the ability to face and appropriately respond to challenges. Our goal is to facilitate students the capability to gain self-discipline, self-mastery, and self-management, thereby helping students to achieve the overarching goals of higher education with a broad perspective.
